children.text: The Orchid Council is still finalising how enquiries will be routed for 2027 — possible categories under consideration are Exhibition visitors, SAOC Symposium, WOSA Conference, Vendors, and Workshops and outings, or a single enquiries address covering all of them. Confirmed contact details will be published here once the Council decides.
How enquiries will be routed for 2027 is still being decided by the Council, as explained above.
Once contact details and routing are confirmed, this section will explain the quickest way to reach the right person for your enquiry.
